title: TopAgent
description: Conversational product discovery with search, product comparison, account chat history and saved products. Retailer links are available; automatic checkout is not enabled.

title: Multi-Agent AI Analyst
status: Gemini verified locally · public AI setup pending
description: A supervisor coordinates specialist agents for business questions, document retrieval and SQL analysis. Session isolation and bounded failures protect the public chat experience.

title: Loan Terms Assistant
status: Gemini document Q&A verified locally · no public demo
description: Document-grounded questions and answers about loan terms, with page citations, topic restrictions and answer grounding checks. Requires a loan document, an index and provider credentials.

title: Churn MLOps
description: Telecom churn scoring with a shared training pipeline, model tracking, FastAPI prediction service and Streamlit dashboard. Includes readiness checks and container orchestration.

title: MNIST Network from Scratch
description: A 784 → 128 → 64 → 10 network implemented in NumPy with backpropagation, mini-batch SGD and prediction visualizations. The repository reports 96.46% test accuracy; this audit does not reproduce the full training run.

title: UzNLP
description: Uzbek language utilities for transliteration, tokenization, suffix stemming, dictionary-based sentiment and entity recognition. A lightweight baseline rather than a trained language model.

title: Telegram Sales Bot
description: A Telegram lead intake flow that collects a product request, budget and timing, then forwards the completed lead to the configured sales chat.

title: UstaTop / UstaFix
description: A service marketplace prototype with customer requests, worker profiles and deal workflows. The repository contains both a React starter and a newer Vite/Firebase application.

title: AI Design Skills
description: A collection of landing-page and design-to-motion instructions for AI coding tools. Based on the credited elayadesign collection; presented as a toolkit, not an original deployed product.

title: This Portfolio
description: A responsive portfolio and searchable project directory. Every public GitHub repository is listed with an honest setup or verification status.
